observations: Actual neutral full head/body and profile A/B show no discernible whole appearance improvement. Existing shape and skin exposure are preserved, without an intentional darkening or lighting change.

Half and closed control renders remain doll-like: smooth, heavy lids with rounded closure, insufficient fold/crease anatomy. Hair remains a flat vertical curtain with uniform ends and a conspicuous ear strip. Body and skin remain smooth; clothing/natural dynamics/runtime remain unfinished.

New control geometry follows actual optical geometry at each sampled pose. Initial static-optical premise failed before a saved model; both original script and failure log remain. Optical world movement reaches approximately2.469mm at full blink; this is measured source behavior, not certified physiological motion.

One adaptive construction adds source controls in the implicated lining region with conforming shared-edge triangles. It reduces sampled interpolation defect from0.158810mm to0.028189mm, but31 faces still miss the fixed0.025mm criterion. No density/offset/tolerance retuning is adopted.

Five sampled actual triangle-surface checks are reported separately from interpolation, closed edges, finite volumes, self/hair/cloth contacts and continuous time. A scoped surface pass cannot certify zero clipping globally.
